# Joshua Slaughter (D): NYS Assembly, District 3

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Joshua Slaughter's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://joshslaughter.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Joe DeStefano](../destefano-joe/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/slaughter-joshua> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A labor leader's biography with big record claims from his years as a county legislative aide. The sewer district is real but cost about $224 million from federal, state and county money. He was a staffer, so "helped secure" is a share of a large collective effort.

1. The Forge River sewer district was first proposed by his former boss, Legislator Kate Browning, in 2006.
2. The open-space and labor-policy claims have no figures or sources on the page.
